input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is the APPROVED COVENANT CREATURE SOURCE, the authority for anatomy, palette and painting style. Use BOTH references visually. Match its lighter stylized painted values and simple sculpted shapes exactly; do not darken into realistic horror, add photoreal skin or fur, or add black shadows. Reference-1 is an A10 master or a crop of that approved source. Generate the requested anatomical view even if the reference is a rear view. This is an ANIMAL ONLY. No human body, no clothes, no weapon or staff, no hands. Keep its exact creature anatomy. For ALL poses the camera sees BACK surfaces. Keep head and torso aimed upper-right away from viewer. Never turn to face the viewer. Raw magical broad squat amphibian-like bog creature, four short splayed legs, heavy moss-green stone hide, broad round mouth, luminous turquoise throat sac, root tendrils and wet mist. Chunky artillery silhouette; intact non-gory creature. REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally AWAY from viewer and toward image RIGHT, back surfaces visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly THREE columns by TWO rows, SIX complete poses. Six resistance poses: ready, lower body braces, forelimbs plant or moth wings fold forward, body withstands force, small effort variation, steady braced hold. No injury or collapse, no shield object or magic effect added to an animal.All complete bodies same anatomical scale, very wide empty magenta gutters. No labels, no text, no anatomy outside its cell. No falling or resting poses. Each equal cell contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only.

arguments.Prompt:
A 3x2 grid animation sprite sheet of 6 defense and bracing resistance poses of the creature shown in reference-1.png and reference-2.png, set against an entirely solid flat uniform vivid magenta background (#FF00FF).

Creature description and consistency:
An animal-only raw magical broad squat amphibian-like bog creature, four short splayed muscular legs, heavy moss-green stone hide, broad round mouth, luminous turquoise throat sac, root tendrils and wet mist. Chunky artillery silhouette, intact non-gory creature. No human anatomy, no clothes, no weapons, no handheld objects.

Viewpoint and Angle:
All 6 poses are strictly viewed from an elevated 55-degree orthographic perspective in REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view (northeast / facing diagonally away from the viewer towards upper-right), showing back surfaces and spine/shell/flanks. The head and torso are aimed upper-right away from the viewer in every single pose; it never turns around to face the camera.

Grid Layout:
Exactly 3 columns and 2 rows forming 6 equal cells, each containing exactly one complete creature at the identical anatomical scale, centered within the middle 60% of each cell. Wide empty magenta gutters between all poses. No cell borders, no grid lines, no text, no numbers, no floor plane, no ground shadows, no background scenery.

Poses (6 defense/resistance progression stages):
1. Top-left: Braced ready defense stance, weight centered low, rear-right angle.
2. Top-middle: Lower body drops and braces deep into stance, four legs gripping wide.
3. Top-right: Forelimbs plant heavily into the ground, shoulders hunching, head tucked firm.
4. Bottom-left: Withstanding heavy impact/force, muscles tense, hide taut, absorbing shock.
5. Bottom-middle: Slight effort variation, throat sac slightly pulsing turquoise, holding strong against pressure.
6. Bottom-right: Steady rock-solid braced hold, completely locked in place, unyielding defense.

Art Style:
Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy illustration, matching reference-1.png and reference-2.png. Sculpted painterly volume, confident brushwork, lighter stylized painted values, mossy green and stone tones with subtle turquoise magical glow. Smooth opaque paint, no photorealism, no 3D render, no noise texture, on pure solid magenta #FF00FF.
